Are you running?

Thinking of You

The story behind the name.

The long way home. Every Miami runner knows the summer route. You head out early before the heat kicks in, and somewhere around mile two, you spot it. A tree heavy with mangoes, branches hanging over the sidewalk. Then another, a few houses down. Before you know it, the whole block is full of them.

You slow down. You fill your shirt. Somebody’s tía waves from the porch and tells you to take more. The run home gets slower, but you don’t mind. You’re already thinking about who you’ll share them with. Your mom. Your abuela. The neighbor who always looks out for you.

That’s Thinking of You. A runner’s find, brought home for the people you love.

Why us. Our run clubs start at the shop on 79th Street, surrounded by the same neighborhood mango trees that make these summer runs special. This one’s for everyone who’s ever taken the long way home, found something worth sharing, and thought of someone else along the way.
